stableFactsAndClaims: The cupboard has forty puzzles; twenty-six are checked, leaving fourteen unchecked on the lower shelf with yellow bands.
Eighteen checked puzzles are complete; eight lack one to five pieces.
Lending incomplete puzzles with clear labels is a volunteer suggestion not approved by the manager; borrowers should make the usability decision.
Some titles are tiny and three boxes lack finished-image pictures; larger labels and photographs are uncosted, with a camera available but no assigned photographer or label maintainer.
Staff propose the existing board-game system, providing fourteen-day loans and one renewal without reservations.
The system records missing-piece notes but not photographs, which would stay with boxes.
Permission is requested to finish checking fourteen puzzles and test returns with two complete puzzles; this does not settle lending incomplete puzzles.
Comments go to the circulation supervisor by Wednesday for the manager's Friday review.
